# JKLU SANKALP 2027 - JK Lakshmipat University International Conference

> JKLU SANKALP 2027 is the premier International Conference organized by JK Lakshmipat University (JKLU), Jaipur.

This portal provides comprehensive information regarding research tracks, paper submissions, conference registration, sponsorship opportunities, keynote sessions, and committee details.

## Public Conference Resources

- [Home](https://sankalp.jklu.edu.in): Official conference homepage, themes, keynote speakers, and conference highlights.
- [Call for Papers](https://sankalp.jklu.edu.in/call-for-papers): Submission guidelines, research topics, publication venues, and important deadlines.
- [Sessions & Tracks](https://sankalp.jklu.edu.in/sessions): Detailed overview of research tracks, session themes, and conference schedules.
- [Registration Information](https://sankalp.jklu.edu.in/registration): Registration categories, pricing tiers for authors and attendees, and inclusions.
- [Register Now](https://sankalp.jklu.edu.in/register): Direct online conference registration and payment gateway for authors and delegates.
- [Sponsors & Partnerships](https://sankalp.jklu.edu.in/sponsors): Official partners, corporate sponsorship tiers, brand visibility benefits, and sponsorship prospectus.
- [About JKLU](https://sankalp.jklu.edu.in/about): Institutional background, vision, leadership, and conference legacy.
- [Organizing Committee](https://sankalp.jklu.edu.in/committee): Patrons, advisory boards, steering committee, and technical program chairs.
- [Venue & Travel](https://sankalp.jklu.edu.in/venue): Campus location, travel directions, accommodation options, and Jaipur city guide.
- [FAQ](https://sankalp.jklu.edu.in/faq): Frequently asked questions about paper submissions, travel, accommodation, and registration.
- [Contact Us](https://sankalp.jklu.edu.in/contact): Official conference desk, support contacts, and inquiries.
- [Credits](https://sankalp.jklu.edu.in/credits): Portal engineering, design, and student developer credits.

## Key Facts

- Event: JKLU SANKALP 2027
- Organizer: Institute of Engineering & Technology, JK Lakshmipat University, Jaipur
- Location: JK Lakshmipat University, Near Mahindra SEZ, Ajmer Road, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302026, India
- General Inquiries: sankalp@jklu.edu.in
- Canonical Domain: https://sankalp.jklu.edu.in
